text: RETRACTED BY AUTHOR: the containing function RelationPreservation.diagnostic has exactly one caller, WorkedExampleSuite.scala:307 - a test. It does NOT feed inference. The inference path (RelationPreservation.reweight, called at hsmm.scala:613) uses bonus.getOrElse(s, 0.0), so a recall with no relations gets no adjustment, which is correct. The defect is real in kind but test-only in consequence; recommend P3 and either the Option treatment or deletion. See coordination post for how the error was made.
